# GeoJSON

**Reference:** IETF RFC 7946  
**Role in ARCA:** current GIS-native output family

ARCA uses GeoJSON because it is inspectable, broadly interoperable, and readily
consumed by open geospatial tooling.

GeoJSON is treated as a spatial data representation, not as a guarantee that
every 3D/BIM semantic can be represented without an ARCA-defined attribute
contract.

ARCA may support additional GIS-native outputs over time without making one
renderer-specific format mandatory.
